project.name: vance-exec
project.description: Vance Exec — the plain-Java core of running programs for a tenant: process specs and the launcher contract, the sealed child environment, isolation argv (bwrap template) and prlimit caps, per-call scratch directories, program probes. Shared by vance-brain (workspace mode local) and the runner (planning/runner.md), consumed by vance-toolpack and vance-foot for the environment policy. No Spring, no MongoDB — the runner must build as a native image. Also the RootDir model of a workspace on disk (descriptors, handlers, the store).
